facts.fact: A passport appointment can be rescheduled up to three times
facts.quote: Users can re-schedule appointments three times except in the case of tatkaal which is once.
facts.note: 'Updated 06-10-2026' in the expected answer is the date of the copy in the bot's index (developer seed), a citation note, not a fact; the live page now shows 'Last updated on: 21/10/2026' and still states the same rule.

facts.fact: A Tatkaal appointment can be rescheduled only once
facts.quote: Users can re-schedule appointments three times except in the case of tatkaal which is once.

summary: Passport Seva applyFor page still says three reschedules, once for Tatkaal.
